low_H_proxy.reason: A 1x2 in-plane C supercell has 12 Mg2Ni units. Three background H atoms give x=3/12=0.25. This is a nearby low-H proxy, not exact Mg2NiH0.3 and not a diffraction-refined H occupancy.
low_H_proxy.origin: Add interstitial H to the Mg2Ni framework of C, never strip nearly all H from the Mg2NiH4 framework.
low_H_proxy.transfer_rule: Move existing H from the MgH2 domain; preserve total Mg60Ni12H75. Nominal Ni-side occupancies become 4/12 and 5/12 only if the relaxed structures confirm the transfer. These are uptake endpoints, not claims of stable homogeneous alpha phases above x=0.3.

spin_note: All NEW references and defects are spin-polarized PBE without U. Do not combine their bare energies with older non-spin calculations. Ni starts at 1.0 muB; this is not an exhaustive magnetic-order search.

provenance.title: Ageing of Mg-Ni-H hydrogen storage alloys
Preparation and Characterization of MgH2 Mechanocomposites with Mg2NiH0.3 + Mg2NiH4-delta Two-Phase Mixture

limitations: Six seeds are built first; nine children require converged parents.
The supplied La interface CONTCAR is a seed, not proof of convergence under new settings.
The pure Mg and MgH2 controls are finite cleavage slabs, not bulk limits or thickness-converged surfaces.
The La vacancy samples one La-derived H site; it is not an exhaustive inequivalent-site survey.
This batch gives endpoint thermodynamics only, not migration/dissociation barriers or a full catalytic cycle.
No new triple interface, fifth H on Mg17La2, DOS/Bader sweep, AIMD or NEB is authorized by this manifest.
